messages.title: PIJ · Tue 17 Nov
messages.body:
• Nasdaq 100 down about 2.7% as Nvidia earnings and Anthropic IPO loom; futures steady
• Anthropic IPO prices Wednesday: 825M shares at $70-78, demand reported 6x, trading Thursday as ANT
• GTA VI launch is 48 hours away: unlock times, no multiplayer, reviews unconfirmed
